analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains below 50. MACD histogram is improving but still negative. The 5-day price pattern is forming a Higher Low relative to the 20-day range, signaling recovery. The SMA20 is acting as resistance, leading to continued sideways movement.
